composition: Front views extracted from the top half of paired sheets; final side views and two corrected front views generated individually with finalViewPrompts.

poses.front: Both lips meet fully in a relaxed horizontal seal; no teeth or tongue visible.
poses.side: Both lips touch fully to close the exit for air. Tongue rests low and neutral with an open oral cavity above it. Show the closure stage of a bilabial stop.
poses.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a single paired reference sheet for an English pronunciation app. Input image 1 supplies the FRONT VIEW visual style; input image 2 supplies the SIDE CUTAWAY style and continuous tongue anatomy. Warm natural peach skin, terracotta lips and tongue, ivory teeth, realistic softly shaded medical textbook illustration on opaque white. Output a portrait 3:4 canvas with EXACTLY TWO equal panels stacked vertically, no dividing line: top half is a 3:2 landscape FRONT close-up of just mouth and nearby skin, bottom half is a 3:2 landscape LEFT-FACING midsagittal side cutaway from nose to chin with full tongue rooted in floor of mouth. Leave a white margin inside each half, subjects centered and contained in their own half. The sheet will be split exactly at the horizontal midpoint into separate front and side illustrations. No text, phonemes, labels, arrows, symbols, borders or UI. Keep one continuous tongue, no floating teeth, one upper and one lower incisor in side cross section. These are static teaching poses, not animation.
Target: bilabial consonants p, b.
TOP FRONT VIEW: Both lips meet fully in a relaxed horizontal seal; no teeth or tongue visible.
BOTTOM SIDE VIEW: Both lips touch fully to close the exit for air. Tongue rests low and neutral with an open oral cavity above it. Show the closure stage of a bilabial stop.

finalViewPrompts.side: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE anatomically clear static English /k/ or /g/ mouth-position teaching illustration. This is a SIDE VIEW only, a midsagittal oral cutaway facing LEFT. Opaque pure white background, landscape 3:2 canvas, warm peach skin, terracotta tongue and lips, ivory teeth and palate bone, softly shaded realistic editorial medical textbook rendering. Fully contain the nose-to-chin profile and tongue root with 8 percent white margin. Crucial target: The rear dorsum of the tongue rises to contact the soft palate and fully blocks the passage there. Tongue tip stays low behind lower incisors. Lips slightly apart. The dorsum must visibly TOUCH THE SOFT PALATE at the rear of the oral cavity, with no air gap at the contact. The anterior tongue remains low and the tongue tip points LEFT toward the lower incisors, never curled down and backward. Draw a single solid tongue connected to the floor and root, no loops. No text, labels, arrows, borders or UI. Do not draw a vowel pose. Show teeth at the front of the mouth only.

poses.side: Upper incisor edge lightly touches the LOWER lip with a tiny friction gap. Lower lip drawn inward under upper incisors; tongue rests low, mouth cavity open above it.
